fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed as stated: a grid of exponents A_i+B_j cannot be a Sidon set because every 2x2 rectangle gives (A_i+B_j)+(A_k+B_l)=(A_i+B_l)+(A_k+B_j). Replacing “Sidon” by distinct mixed-radix valuations is a new mutation and still requires the enlarged-kernel and sub-17E audits.

Proposal 2 is the sole survivor for one experiment, not a Q1 result. Full-spark language does not overcome rank-one product restrictions, DROP, or newly created zero-syndrome primitives; only a complete serialized matrix and recomputed Graver/shell certificate can decide it.

Proposal 3 is killed for this run: every finite voltage has finite order, so a nonclosing base circuit has a closing multiple, while signed-flow splicing remains possible. No explicit cocycle, lift-energy lower bound, or symbolic defeat of the known exchange is supplied.

Proposal 4 is blocked by the missing shell-sufficiency theorem. A zero-transfer movement outside one local shell may participate in recursive gluing or cancellation, so finite shell separation cannot replace Q1 without an all-lift Q2/Q3 argument.

Proposal 5 is killed as specified: F_{17^4}[X;sigma] is an infinite skew-polynomial ring, not the claimed finite skew field, and no quotient, positive-definite order, two-sided prime, or Euclidean trace factor is defined. Larger residue dimension alone also does not defeat product-rank kernels.

Proposal 6 proves only a conditional quadratic estimate and cannot discriminate the frontier until three orthogonal surviving directions with the stated energy bounds are certified in an actual full tile. Regression on an already killed margin-only completion adds no frontier evidence.

Even a Proposal-2 finite pass would leave Q2 section stabilization, carry/lumpability, Q3 positive cycle means, G28 strict growth, and the compiler/parameter lemmas entirely open. No finite Q1 evidence may be promoted to an asymptotic hardness theorem.
evidence: Current exact evidence kills the serialized one-channel margin-only completions: E=18 and a malformed zero-transfer lift has energy 42<306 in every tested fiber. Lean proves only that three surviving directions into one F_17^2 symbol have a bounded dependency; it does not cover multiple channels or a missing full tile.

Multiple independent product channels genuinely mutate the current obstruction: r channels provide 2r residue dimensions and can separate the certified one-channel dependency without introducing direct-product multiplication, provided each channel is transported componentwise. Product restrictions may nevertheless force a new common kernel, which is exactly finitely testable.

The ROADMAP frontier is Q1 and requires the actual maximal-order NAND/fusion/COPY rows, common legal energy, saturation, DROP and false fibers, both orientations, and complete projected-fiber Graver separation. Proposal 2 can test these requirements at constant N=8; the other proposals either contain a structural error or lack a frontier-instantiating certificate.

Emitting all constraints would avoid G1/G6/G7, and complete signed Graver plus unrestricted shell enumeration would cover the affine, parity, bag, splice, diagonal, toric-exchange, and DROP obstructions. G30, G33–34, A5, D4, and E6 are irrelevant because the surviving experiment uses none of those mechanisms.
